hook.name: VladdyHook
hook.description: A fee-taking hook for native ETH/TOKEN pools that intercepts swaps to collect ETH-denominated fees, instantly distributing them to configurable recipients, a platform wallet, and a buyback reserve. Supports multiple distribution modes: direct recipient payouts, token buyback-and-burn, staking rewards (robin mode), lottery draws, and protocol-owned liquidity minting.
